title_en: Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation: Call for 2027 Scholarship Recommendations
summary: The Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation is selecting new scholarship recipients for the 2027 academic year, and each department may recommend at most one eligible student to the College of Engineering. Departments must submit the recommendation form (Attachment 3) by 15:00 on Tuesday 27 October 2026; the final candidate will be notified to departments at 15:00 on 28 October 2026 and must submit documents by 30 October 2026. Only students of Korean nationality who meet all eligibility conditions may be recommended; the notice does not state how individual students should approach their department.
applies_to: Optional (not mandatory). Eligible for recommendation: holders of Republic of Korea nationality who are expected to register for the first semester of their third year as of Spring 2027, and who meet all three conditions: at least 12 credits completed in every regular semester, an overall percentage grade of 85 or above across all semesters, and no disciplinary record under the university regulations (including academic discipline). Recommendations are made by departments, at most one student per department; the College of Engineering will recommend one student in total.

conditions: Only holders of Republic of Korea nationality are eligible.
Only students expected to register for the first semester of their third year as of Spring 2027 are eligible.
The student must have completed at least 12 credits in every regular semester.
The student's overall percentage grade across all semesters must be 85 or above.
The student must have no disciplinary record under the university regulations, including academic discipline.
Each department may recommend at most one student, and the College of Engineering will recommend one student in total.
If a department does not reply by the deadline, it will be treated as having no recommendee.

If more students apply than the one available place, students with preference points are selected first, and the candidate is chosen based on overall grades (grade point average and credits completed).
Students with leadership experience or special talents receive additional points in the document review.
Submitting documents does not guarantee selection as the College of Engineering or Seoul National University recommendee.
The Foundation selects recipients by document review and interview.
The scholarship is either full tuition or an academic incentive of 3.5 million won, for up to 2 years (up to 4 regular semesters).
The documents to be submitted will be announced separately, only to the student selected as the College of Engineering recommendee.

translation:
2027 Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation Scholarship: Call for Recommendations

The Korea Leadership Development Scholarship Foundation is selecting new scholarship recipients for the 2027 academic year as set out below. Please recommend an eligible student by 15:00 on Tuesday 27 October 2026.

A. Eligible for recommendation: holders of Republic of Korea nationality who are expected to register for the first semester of their third year as of the first semester (Spring) of 2027.

B. Number of recommendations: at most 1 per department. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend 1 student.

C. Eligibility: students who meet all three of the following conditions:
1) Completed at least 12 credits in every regular semester
2) Overall percentage grade across all semesters of 85 or above
3) No disciplinary record under the university regulations (including academic discipline)
※ Preference: students with leadership experience and students with special talents receive additional points in the document review.

D. Scholarship amount: full tuition or an academic incentive of 3.5 million won.

E. Payment period: up to 2 years (up to 4 regular semesters).

F. College of Engineering recommendee selection procedure
1) Submission of the department recommendation form [Attachment 3]: Tuesday 27 October 2026
※ At most 1 recommendation per department. If there is no reply by the deadline, the department will be treated as having no recommendee.
※ If more than the number of places (1) apply, students eligible for additional points are selected first, and the recommendee is chosen by evaluation based on overall grades (grade point average and credits completed).
※ Please note in advance that, regardless of document submission, a student may not be selected as the College of Engineering recommendee or the Seoul National University recommendee.
2) Notification of the final recommendee to departments: Wednesday 28 October 2026, 15:00
3) Document submission by the final recommendee: Friday 30 October 2026

G. Selection method: Foundation document review and interview.

H. Documents to submit: after the recommendation forms are returned and reviewed by the College of Engineering, the documents required will be announced separately to the student selected as the College of Engineering recommendee.

Attachment (1 file): 2026학년도 한국지도자육성장학재단 장학생 추천서식.xlsx (16 KB) (the attachment was not read; note that its file name refers to the 2026 academic year).
